purpose: Close the shared Runtime input/session, frame preview/canonical, and control/diagnostics boundaries needed for repeatable Windows/Web verification without entering FC-01 feature implementation.

materialization.exact_ref_rule: Use the immutable package commit SHA in the P32 surface_handoff; never pin package.json to its own future SHA.
materialization.fc01_protection: FC-01 worktree, branch, Authority, Gate, Evidence and historical results remain untouched and are not an input mutation surface.

terminal_target: PACKAGE_READY_FOR_CONTROL_REVIEW before P32; after acceptance, READY_FOR_CONTROL_REVIEW with exact implementation result and evidence refs
nonclaims: No FC-01 P31/P32 or FC-01 DEV/P34 result
No PX0, G4.6, G4.7, FC-13 or G5 status change
No Android APK or Android physical evidence in this package
No public C ABI delivery; docs/api remains implementation input
No new OperationKind, ObjectKind, FieldId, Protobuf field, or canonical product policy
No complete Editor composition extraction, dynamic capability registry, Inspector, Sync, background schema or export feature
